en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad,f rom Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Zareyf, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Abdullah bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is not, with regards to a pumpkin seed and the small insects, an Ablution (Wudhu). But rather, it is at the status of the lice’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Zarif from Tha’labah ibn Maymun from ‘Abd Allah ibn Yazid who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not necessary to take Wudu’ because of the coming out of one’s buttock, such things as pumpkin seeds or small worms; they are like lice.’”
